theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂

  case par.par ha' hb' =>
    exact (iha ha').elim fun c hc => (ihb hb').elim fun d hd =>
      ⟨_, .par hc.1 hd.1, .par hc.2 hd.2⟩
  case' par.red_I | par.red_K | par.red_S => apply symm

  case red_I.par ha hb | par.red_I =>
      exact I_irreducible _ ha ▸ ⟨_, hb, .red_I _⟩

(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)

    fun n => Set.mem_univ fun k : Fin 4 =>

theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  let N := digits_to_num
  subst digits_to_num
  intro d e f h
  have H {a b} (hab : relation a b) i :
      7 ∣ b i * 10 ^ i.1 - a i * 10 ^ i.1 + N a := by
    refine Int.dvd_trans (((hrelation a b).mp hab).2 i) (dvd_of_eq ?_)
    rw [← Int.sub_eq_iff_eq_add, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    simp only [ite_mul, ite_sub, sub_self, Fintype.sum_ite_eq']
  intro i
  have hc : IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) 10 := by decide
  apply (hc.pow_right (n := i.1)).dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
  refine Int.dvd_trans (Int.dvd_sub (Int.dvd_sub (Finset.dvd_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun j _ => H h.1 j))
    (Int.dvd_mul_right 7 (N d)))
    (Int.dvd_add (H h.1 i) (H h.2 i))) (dvd_of_eq ?_)
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const,
    Finset.card_fin]
  ring

lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let c := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  let t := ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (timeOrderF (𝓕 := 𝓕))
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂ (LinearMap.ext_basis
    (B := (mulLinearMap.comp $ mulLinearMap.flip c).compr₂ t)
    (B' := mulLinearMap.compr₂ $ ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ mulLinearMap c ∘ₗ timeOrderF) ofCrAnListFBasis ofCrAnListFBasis
    fun φs' φs ↦ ?_) a b
  dsimp [mulLinearMap_apply]
  simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
  obtain ⟨l1, l2, hs⟩ :
      ∃ l1 l2, ∀ l,
        (∀ x ∈ l, crAnTimeOrderRel φ x ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel x φ) →
        crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ l ++ φs) = l1 ++ l ++ l2 :=
    ⟨_, _, fun l h ↦ (insertionSort_of_eq_list _ _ _ _ _ h).trans
      (List.append_assoc _ _ _)⟩
  trans crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
    ι (ofCrAnListF l1 * c * ofCrAnListF l2)
  · simp only [c, t, LinearMap.comp_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply,
      ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF,
      mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc,
      map_sub, map_smul, ← ofCrAnListF_append,
      List.cons_append, List.nil_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
    rw [hs [φ, ψ] $ by simp [hφψ, hψφ], hs [ψ, φ] $ by simp [hφψ, hψφ]]
    simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
    rw [crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ, smul_sub, smul_comm]
  simp only [c, map_mul]
  rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp $ ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ,
    mul_assoc, ← map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append,
    ← List.append_nil l1, ← hs [] $ by simp, List.append_nil]
  by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) = (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
  · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ hq.symm,
      ← crAnTimeOrderSign, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
    simp only [map_smul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
  · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, smul_zero]
